name: Haus Mangweth
beschreibung: The Haus Mangweth is situated in a quiet location in the Tiroler Alpine region, with views of the surrounding mountain peaks. The rooms are furnished in Tiroler country-house style and equipped with modern bathrooms. The restaurant offers a selection of regional specialties prepared with local products. In the surrounding area, guests can hike or go mountain biking in summer, and skiing is possible in winter. The atmosphere of the house is described as cozy and inviting. Hiking trails start directly behind the house. Nearby ski areas can be reached by car.
